However, further detailing of the study is required to optimize capital and operating costs by estimating the detailed bill of quantities. The waste generated from the project needs to be further analyzed, and the corresponding emission limit needs to be further examined. Considering the same, a FEED study for the project is recommended. 6.0 Structure of the Study Report The Pre-FEED study outcome is described in the following attachments.
